svg.title: Prefill claims most of a request's cache in one step; decode adds the rest gradually
svg.desc: A cache-size-over-time chart. The cache jumps almost vertically from empty to most of its eventual size during the single prefill step, processing the whole prompt at once, then rises in a slow, steady staircase during decode as each output token adds one more token's worth of cache. A worked example shows a 2048-token prompt claiming about 640 megabytes at prefill while 128 decode steps add only about 40 more megabytes, six percent of the total.
svg.text: Example: a 2048-token prompt claims ~640 MB at prefill; 128 decode steps add only ~40 MB more (6% of the total).
